tactic: Eliminate tower/gate first-pass failures and cut p100 wall time to at most 60 s via exact selection and content-addressed reuse.

necessary.statement: 22.5 % of the gate's runs fail and it takes 119 s.

parallel.statement: Make the gate right first, then fast: a red run costs a whole round.

sufficiency.statement: First pass and time are the two conditions of the gate.
